statement: Implement Modern transformer components: combine RoPE RMSNorm SwiGLU and grouped-query attention with shape and parameter audits. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use tinyshakespeare; required output: [N,T] tokens -> [N,T,V] logits. Evaluate bpc (minimize). RoPE even pairs RMSNorm epsilon SwiGLU width and GQA head sharing. Required ablation: Replace one component at a time using matched token and parameter budgets. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
